title: zoe task review --request-file (per-AC acceptance verdict)
description: Output contract of the per-acceptance-criterion review (v1.7 second acceptance layer). Produced by a reviewer in an independent context and submitted by the host; the runtime validates it. Invalid output is recorded as `invalid` and rejected — it never becomes a pass. Every acceptance id declared by the frozen spec must appear exactly once, every evidence ref must resolve to a record of *this* candidate, and `subject_sha` must equal `validated_sha`.

subject_sha.description: Must equal the task's current validated_sha. A review of an older candidate is not a review of this delivery.

reviewer.description: Who produced the review. `independent_context` is a declaration, not a proof; the runtime records it and additionally refuses a reviewer whose profile_id / run_id / actor produced the candidate.

acceptance_id.description: Must be one of the acceptance ids declared by the frozen spec.

status.description: PASS / FAIL / NOT_VERIFIED. There is no 'skipped': an unchecked item is NOT_VERIFIED, and NOT_VERIFIED must be acknowledged item by item at accept time.

finding.description: Required for FAIL and NOT_VERIFIED: what is wrong, or what could not be judged.

locations.description: Repository-relative paths only. Absolute paths and '..' escapes are refused.

evidence_refs.description: check:<id> (PASS on this candidate), evidence:<evidence_id> (must be the current one), doc:<path> (exists in the candidate tree), or decision:<id> (declared in this spec). Fabricated refs are rejected exactly like missing ones.

suggested_action.description: Advisory only: never executed as a shell command.
